usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the `reminders <date>` command. It uses the reminder rule now in force, DEC-C08 (48 hours before the appointment), and `help` lists it right after `reminder <appointment>`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 8 tests, including new ones for ordering, bad input and leaving the data unchanged; work and report are committed.
Two open questions: the existing `reminder` command still uses the replaced 24-hour rule (DEC-C06), so it and `reminders` disagree on the same appointment, and I left it unchanged. Appointments at the same date and time are listed by ID, which the requirement doesn't specify.

OUTCOME: completed
